rationale: B is clearer and more idiomatic overall, especially through its use of fmt-based alignment and straightforward integer amount formatting. More importantly, its grouping logic handles arbitrarily large amounts correctly and field-width overflow degrades gracefully, whereas A's formatAmount misgroups values with more than six integer digits and padLeft can panic when a formatted amount exceeds the column width. A has better date validation and Unicode-safe description handling, but those advantages do not outweigh its correctness and robustness problems for large monetary values.
